chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad al-Basri, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur al-'Ammi, who reported from Abu 'Ali al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who heard from Abu Muhammad al-Wabishi, reporting from Abu al-Ward who said: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, saying:

"When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah will gather all people on one plane, from the first to the last, naked and barefooted. They will be made to stand on the road to the gathering place until they sweat profusely and their breathing becomes difficult. They will remain in that state for as long as Allah wills, and that is what He, the Exalted, says: 'and you shall hear nothing but whispers' [20:108]. Then an announcer will call from the direction of the Throne: 'Where is the unlettered Prophet?' The people will say: 'You have made all hear, so name him.' Then it will be announced: 'Where is the Prophet of Mercy, Muhammad son of Abdullah?' Then the Messenger of Allah will rise and stand before all the people until he reaches a Pool whose length is the distance between Ayla and Sana'a. He will stand at it, then call for your master, who will rise and stand with him. Then the people will be given permission to pass."

Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Among them on that Day will be those who arrive and those who are turned away. When the Messenger of Allah sees those turned away from among those who love us, the People of the House, he will weep and say: 'O Lord, the partisans of 'Ali! O Lord, the partisans of 'Ali!' Then Allah will send an angel who will say: 'What makes you weep, O Muhammad?' He will say: 'How can I not weep for people from among the partisans of my brother 'Ali ibn Abi Talib? I see them being turned towards the companions of the Fire and prevented from reaching my Pool!' Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will say: 'O Muhammad, I have given them to you, and pardoned their sins for your sake, and joined them with you and with those of your progeny whom they used to follow, and placed them in your group, and brought them to your Pool, and accepted your intercession for them, and honored you with that.'"

Then Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon them, said: "How many will weep on that Day, men and women, crying out 'O Muhammad!' when they witness that. Not one who follows us and loves us will remain on that Day except that he will be in our party, with us, and will arrive at our Pool."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about the Prophet's intercession for the followers of Ahlul Bayt on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir describes the Day of Resurrection when all humanity will be gathered naked and barefoot, sweating in distress. The Prophet Muhammad will be called to stand at his Pool (al-Hawd), and Imam 'Ali will stand beside him. When the Prophet sees followers of the Ahlul Bayt being turned away, he will weep and plead with Allah, who will then grant them forgiveness, unite them with the Prophet's progeny, and accept his intercession. The Imam concludes that every sincere follower of the Ahlul Bayt will ultimately be saved through this intercession. This hadith was addressed to the early Shia community, providing them hope and reassurance about divine mercy and the Prophet's advocacy for those devoted to his family.
